name: surface-canvas
usage: Page and desktop background; the plain wallpaper.

name: surface-raised
usage: Solid content surface: window bodies, dialogs, plates behind secondary text on glass.

name: surface-raised-high
usage: Cards on the canvas.

name: surface-glass
usage: Translucent chrome fill: top bar, window frames, menus, widgets. Only ink-strong may be placed directly on it.

name: surface-glass-solid
usage: Opaque fallback of surface-glass (user switch, performance guard, reduced transparency, high contrast).

name: surface-scrim
usage: Scrim behind modal dialogs, scoped to the owning window.

name: edge-glass
usage: 1 px edge of a glass element.

name: divider
usage: Hairlines and the border of an inactive window (at least 1.5:1 against the backdrop).

name: control-border
usage: Boundary of inputs, checkboxes and other controls (3:1 against the surface).

name: ink-strong
usage: Primary text; the only colour allowed directly on glass.

name: ink-muted
usage: Secondary text on solid surfaces only.

name: link
usage: Text in the brand hue and links; links in running text are underlined.

name: focus-ring
usage: Focus indicator of every component; never the primary colour.

name: primary
usage: Brand colour, fill of primary buttons (not a required boundary, Q57).

name: on-primary
usage: Label on a primary fill.

name: primary-hover
usage: Hover fill of a primary button.

name: primary-pressed
usage: Pressed fill of a primary button.

name: primary-disabled
usage: Disabled fill of a primary button.

name: on-primary-disabled
usage: Label on a disabled primary button.

name: status-default-text
usage: Text of a default (informational) badge.

name: status-default-bg
usage: Fill of a default badge.

name: status-success-text
usage: Text of a success badge.

name: status-success-bg
usage: Fill of a success badge.

name: status-warning-text
usage: Text of a warning badge.

name: status-warning-bg
usage: Fill of a warning badge.

name: status-danger-text
usage: Text of a danger badge.

name: status-danger-bg
usage: Fill of a danger badge.

name: status-neutral-text
usage: Text of a neutral badge.

name: status-neutral-bg
usage: Fill of a neutral badge.

name: solid-danger-fill
usage: Solid danger fill (destructive button, error banner).

name: solid-danger-text
usage: Label on solid-danger-fill.

name: solid-success-fill
usage: Solid success fill.

name: solid-success-text
usage: Label on solid-success-fill.

name: solid-warning-fill
usage: Solid warning fill.

name: solid-warning-text
usage: Label on solid-warning-fill.

name: wallpaper-darkest
usage: Luminance bound of the built-in wallpaper: the darkest colour it may show (VL-9; checked against the rendered wallpaper).

name: wallpaper-lightest
usage: Luminance bound of the built-in wallpaper: the lightest colour it may show.
